description: Alberta’s assessment catalogue describes modelling for the proposed Sasol Canada GTL plant, about 40 km northeast of Edmonton in Strathcona County. The proposal would convert natural gas into diesel, naphtha and liquefied petroleum gas with a stated capacity of 96000 barrels per day. Its assessment was deemed complete in 2014. Named components explicitly identify CALMET meteorology, a CALPUFF dispersion model, a groundwater numerical model, multiple-pathway human-health and ecological-risk models, and highway-intersection traffic-impact assessments. Other descriptors include emission inventory, monitoring and laboratory data. This is a documented simulation application to a proposed industrial facility. The source lists PDF reports and XLS/XLSX supporting components. Numerical effects, validation quality, model settings and actual construction or operation are not established. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue provides descriptive metadata and exact original Alberta distribution identifiers. It labels the collection Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is through the linked descriptive record; current provider access and actual file downloads are untested. Costs are not stated. No document, workbook, archive or dataset body was fetched, and numerical contents have not been independently checked. Related editions and components are grouped only where the source identifies their relationship.
